The interaction escalates from confrontation to active deployment of force by police against an individual, occurring within a context of collective tension and crowd presence, satisfying the definition of riot as violent unrest involving group dynamics and use of force.

rejected.reason: No collective violent unrest is visible; police are in formation, individuals walk past or gesture nonviolently (e.g., raised arm without aggression), and no property destruction, clashes, or crowd violence occurs.
